extension.summary: Widgets and skin helpers for Kodi
extension.description: Widget paths and skin helpers for Kodi skins: Next Up, in-progress and recently added media (grouped by show and season), recently aired and recently released, upcoming episodes from Sonarr, movie collections in progress, path statistics, and background fanart rotation.
extension.news:
v1.0.1 (2026-11-16) - Removed the suggestions, similar items and more-by-actor widgets (morebyactor, similarmovies, similartvshows, tvsimilar, suggestions, tvsuggestions) - Widgets refresh through Kodi itself on library changes and playback start/stop; the refreshwidgets action now sets FlatscanWidgetUpdate to a new value instead of pulsing it - Fixed: TV show genre items had no labels and did not open; path statistics items showed no plot
v1.0.0 (2026-10-31) - First release of Flatscan Widgets for Kodi 21 (Omega) - Next Up, Recently Added Grouped, Recently Aired and Sonarr Upcoming Episodes widgets - Movie widgets: Recently Released, Next in Collection, Collections in Progress - Background service: fanart rotation, artwork pre-caching, widget refresh on library updates
